description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for verifying the behavior of git commit authoring options, such as --author, --amend, --reset-author, and handling of special conditions like cherry-picks and merge messages.

methods.name: author_header
methods.description: Retrieves the author line from a specific commit object using git cat-file commit and sed.

methods.name: message_body
methods.description: Retrieves the message body from a specific commit object using git cat-file commit and sed.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Generates a file path for a git object based on its sha1 hash.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Removes a specific git object file from the objects directory.
